The Parable of the Pressing Prophet

On gegenpressing as a spiritual discipline, and the sanctity of the seven seconds after losing the ball.

A wild man came preaching in the wilderness of Westphalia, and his gospel was this: lose the ball, and do not mourn — hunt. On the holiness of the counter-press.
